title: Cloud Database RDS Audit Error Log

compliance.assurance_rationale: Saved search evidence for AU-2 when alert outputs are archived.

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `aws:rds:audit` events matching `*` into `index=aws`. Confirm UC-4.12.2 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:rds:audit` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=aws` sourcetype=`aws:rds:audit` collected via Cloud provider TA database inputs; validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.
spl:
index=aws sourcetype="aws:rds:audit"
| table _time host db user action query

description: Monitors managed cloud database signal: RDS Audit Error Log. This UC monitors `aws:rds:audit` for cloud database rds audit error log and surfaces events for SOC triage, change review, and compliance evidence.
value: RDS Audit Error Log anomalies affect data availability and query performance. Detecting cloud database rds audit error log early reduces mean time to contain cloud incidents, supports audit logging controls, and prevents silent misconfiguration drift across accounts.
implementation: Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:rds:audit.
visualization: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report.
knownFalsePositives: Approved change windows; documented automation service principals; sandbox accounts excluded via lookup.
detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure Cloud provider TA database inputs with the modular input for `aws:rds:audit`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.12.1.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `host` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure required cloud inputs per provider guide; index=aws sourcetype=aws:rds:audit.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:rds:audit" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:rds:audit"
| table _time host db user action query
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.12.2_cloud_database_rds_audit_2"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:rds:audit` in `index=aws` to detect cloud database rds audit error log. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `host` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_12_2_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Dashboard panel, alert, and weekly compliance report..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Cloud provider TA database inputs and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of cloud database rds audit error log so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
